Synopsis:
The USDA is launching measures to support the U.S. beef industry amid record-high consumer prices driven by drought, wildfires, and a cattle herd at 75-year lows. Actions include guaranteed loans for small meat processors, allowing grazing on conserved lands post-disaster, and promoting market transparency. Separately, Trump signed an order expanding lower-tariff beef imports to ease prices, drawing backlash from farm groups.
